mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Graph Neural Networks chapter! You have built a complete molecular property prediction system that encodes both atom and bond features, performs bond-aware message passing, and uses multi-scale readout for graph-level predictions. This architecture mirrors state-of-the-art models like MPNN (Message Passing Neural Network) and GIN (Graph Isomorphism Network) used in real drug discovery pipelines. The multi-task learning approach you implemented allows sharing of molecular representations across related properties, improving sample efficiency. You now have a deep understanding of GNNs from basic convolutions to advanced applications in chemistry and biology.
